description: accoCOMMENT A contextual, text-based commentary tool with support for ratings, attachments, and workflow options Create, edit, and save contextual comments and actions directly inside Power BI — with full writeback support. If you experience issues purchasing through AppSource, please contact us for alternative licensing options. Why accoCOMMENT? Organizations often struggle to capture the why behind the numbers. Email threads, Excel notes, and disconnected systems make it difficult to store business context consistently. accoCOMMENT solves this by enabling users to comment directly in Power BI: Add business explanations to KPIs Document anomalies and data quality issues Capture management commentary for financial reporting Collect structured feedback Attach supporting documents to specific numbers Enhance collaboration directly in the BI workflow As a native Power BI visual, you maintain the full flexibility of Power BI — both technically and visually — while enabling a powerful commenting workflow without switching systems. What is accoCOMMENT? accoCOMMENT is a Power BI custom visual that enables users to create context-dependent comments and actions tied directly to any number, visual, slice, or filtered dataset in Power BI.
